title: Checking words and allowing farewell

captions.emotions: Feeling the loss of familiar words

meaning: You can examine a familiar conversational foundation and recognise sadness for known words while noticing a condition that closeness requires understanding without clarification.
text: The Devil in the physical position of your Vishuddha can appear in tying closeness to faultless understanding. The Tower in energy supports a wish to examine a familiar foundation rather than defend an attractive appearance of agreement. Death in emotions brings farewell to known words. You can discover that a precious formula no longer helps an answer be heard and still miss its simplicity. Checking specific meaning does not declare all earlier closeness imaginary.

For example, clarification receives “We always understood each other without words”. The phrase makes questioning a sign of insufficient participation. You can check what is actually known now rather than require guessing. **Clarification does not cancel closeness or farewell its value**. You discuss an unclear request and hear an actual answer. A beautiful formula must be left in its earlier unlimited sense. It can be missed although today’s exchange became more honest and no longer needs faultless guessing.

Loss strengthens an extreme if every shared understanding seems suspicious after checking. Ending a convenient assumption then becomes distrust of all words. The constructive Tower helps examine the present exchange’s actual foundation rather than destroy an earlier meaning. You can recognise why the phrase mattered and ask directly now; farewell concerns requiring advance understanding of everything rather than discovering each other through living response.
